item: row 269: chart hovers reach touch; no SVG title child anywhere; SVG marks keep a screen-reader name
summary: Chart marks (rhythm grid, donut, dumbbell, mind maps, slope chart, small multiples, concept tree) carry their hover in a title attribute so the #oo-tip bubble opens on touch long-press; a guard fails on any SVG title child under src/static; ooTipInit names titled SVG marks (aria-label plus role graphics-symbol/group, skipped inside svg role=img), axe ARIA rules clean in Chromium.
